job.text: "Well?" cried the parrot, eagerly, "is he gone?" "Yes, my dear, he is gone!" replied <DW53>, gayly. "Oh, dear me! what a pleasant ride I have had! Why didn't you come too, Miss Mary? You might have held on by his hair. It would have been such fun! Yes, I went on quite a good bit with him, just to show him the way, you know. And then I bade him good-by, and begged him to come again; but he didn't say he would." <DW53> shook himself, and
